You are the generic-game / non-MHW path bug-hunt support agent for fengie/mhw-mods. This is an EXECUTION assignment.

MANDATORY TRAINING BEFORE TASK WORK:
Read AGENTS.md, NEXT-AGENT-START-HERE.md, _AGENT_TRAINING/README.md, _AGENT_TRAINING/PROMPT_TEMPLATES/00_SWARM_RULES.txt, _AGENT_CONTEXT/README_FIRST.md, CURRENT_REVISION.json, CONTINUITY_PROTOCOL.md, LEARNED_RULES.md, CURRENT_STATE.md, NEXT_STEPS.md, VERIFICATION.md, plugins/README.md and plugins/PLUGIN_GAP_BACKLOG.md. Establish exact current origin/main and inspect active ownership. This worktree began detached at 2fe9ff1b59077b0cad8281fc4096c125e3dfd948; fetch and move detached HEAD to latest origin/main before any edit if main advanced. Never touch the dirty canonical checkout.

SCOPE: generic-game/non-MHW correctness and path/state isolation. Do not work on unified catalog PR #208, startup performance #219, current Smart Inbox fixes, legacy migration, release-validator, diagnostics identity.

HUNT:
- generic game profile creation/switching; invalid/missing game roots; relative/absolute/path traversal handling; switching between games; per-game state bleed; mod library/deploy roots; source/target containment; launch executable path; duplicate game IDs/names; Unicode/long paths; deleted roots; read-only roots; reopen/restart after switch; generic-game install/enable/disable/conflict workflows where supported.
- Use only temp/sandbox game roots and manager state. Never touch real installed games or user mod data.
- Search docs/source/tests before judging intended behavior. Reproduce before CONFIRMED. Classify CONFIRMED BUG / LIKELY BUG / CODE RISK / UX ISSUE / ENHANCEMENT.

IF CONFIRMED:
Check branches/PRs before branch creation. Reuse compatible owned work or create one narrow branch from fresh origin/main. Implement root-cause fix + regression, run focused and affected broader tests, self-review/diff-check, push/open PR if possible. No force-push; no merge unless exact-head green and current-main reconciled.

IF NO CONFIRMED BUG:
Return tested coverage/risk evidence and next best repro, without inventing issues.

FINAL: STATUS; BASE/FINAL SHA; CLASSIFICATION; REPRO; ROOT CAUSE; CHANGES; TESTS; BRANCH/PR; REMAINING RISKS; NEXT EXACT ACTION.
